functionDeclarations.description: Record the stay dates + party size. The return lists each available room type with rate and view - that is reference material for answering "how much?" / "what's the cheapest?" and for OFFERING the choice to the caller. Never act on it by picking a type yourself; the next step after this tool is a question, not another tool call.
functionDeclarations.name: set_stay

check_in.description: Check-in date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-01-20").
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Check-out date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.
check_out.title: Check Out

guests.description: Number of guests (must be >= 1; ask the caller if not specified).
guests.title: Guests
